scenario_config._comment: All values SI units: metres, seconds, metres/second, metres/second^2. car_start_position_m and obstacle_position_m must match the static translations baked into worlds/obstacle_braking.wbt (the car's and obstacle Solid's X translation) since the world file is not procedurally generated from this config.

failure_reasons: car moved only 0.00 m (< 3 m required)
car max speed 0.94 m/s (< 2 m/s required)
front sensor readings did not change meaningfully
obstacle distance did not decrease meaningfully while approaching
car never came to a safe stop
simulation timed out without reaching a stop
at least one invalid sensor/telemetry reading was reported
